task1.title: Request for a Change of Appointment
task1.prompt:
You are unable to attend an appointment you have scheduled next week. Write a letter to the person in charge. In your letter: 
- Explain why you cannot attend the appointment 
- Suggest a new date and time for the appointment 
- Apologize for any inconvenience caused. 

Make sure to provide details about the original appointment and your reason for rescheduling. Your letter should be at least 150 words.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Society
task2.prompt: Technology has transformed how we live, work, and communicate. While many argue that technology brings significant benefits to society, others believe it has negative effects. Discuss both sides and give your own opinion. In your essay, examine the advantages that technology offers, such as improved communication and efficiency, as well as the drawbacks, including social isolation and privacy concerns. Conclude with your personal viewpoint on whether the benefits of technology outweigh its disadvantages. Your response should be at least 250 words.
